description:
Build the Future of Quality — With AI in Your Toolkit

We're looking for a Senior Test Automation Engineer who's ready to work at the intersection of quality engineering and generative AI. This isn't a traditional QA role — it's a chance to shape how modern teams ship reliable software by combining deep automation expertise with cutting-edge GenAI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and the OpenAI API.

If you believe quality is a strategic advantage (not just a checkbox), and you thrive in environments where automation, data, and AI converge — keep reading.

What You'll Do

  • Own test automation strategy end-to-end for key product areas — from framework architecture to execution and continuous improvement.
  • Harness GenAI tools daily to generate test cases, parse logs, surface edge cases, and accelerate exploratory testing in ways most teams haven't tried yet.
  • Build and scale Selenium-based frameworks (Python, Java, or JavaScript) that keep regression suites fast, stable, and meaningful across browsers and environments.
  • Wire automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps — ensuring every code change is validated before it ships.
  • Analyze test results and production data to uncover failure patterns, define quality KPIs (coverage, defect density, MTTD), and present actionable insights to engineering leadership.
  • Review automation code and mentor junior engineers on framework best practices, GenAI-assisted workflows, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Partner with product and dev teams from the design phase — defining acceptance criteria, testability requirements, and quality standards before a single line of code is written.

What Makes This Role Different

  • AI-first QA workflow. GenAI tools and cloud infrastructure are already provisioned — no fighting for budget or buy-in.
  • Embedded, not siloed. You work alongside engineers from design through deployment, not downstream from them.
  • Lean documentation. No 50-page test plans. Every artifact is living, actionable, and tied to automated checks.
  • Signal over noise. Test suites are actively pruned — every test earns its spot in the pipeline.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in software QA, with at least 3 years dedicated to test automation.
  • Selenium WebDriver expertise — Page Object Model, explicit/implicit waits, cross-browser execution.
  • Strong coding ability in Python, Java, or JavaScript for framework development and scripting.
  • Proven experience with GenAI tools (OpenAI API, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) applied to real engineering workflows.
  • CI/CD familiarity — hands-on with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps pipeline configuration.
  • Data analysis chops — comfortable writing SQL, parsing logs, and building dashboards with Grafana, Tableau, or comparable tools.
  • Clear communication skills — you translate technical test outcomes into business-impact language for stakeholders.
  • Remote-ready mindset — self-directed, organized, and effective in asynchronous, distributed teams.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with API testing (Postman, REST Assured, Playwright).
  • Familiarity with performance testing tools (JMeter, k6, Locust).
  • Hands-on work with Docker or Kubernetes for containerized test environments.
  • Background in security testing, accessibility testing, or mobile automation (Appium).
  • Contributions to open-source automation projects.

What You'll Gain

  • Pioneering GenAI-QA practices that put you ahead of the industry curve.
  • Deep CI/CD pipeline engineering experience across production-grade, multi-product architectures.
  • Executive-level quality strategy skills — building dashboards, forecasting defect trends, and influencing product roadmaps through data.
  • A clear growth path toward Staff QA Engineer or QA Manager, with real mentorship and leadership opportunities along the way.

This is a role for someone who sees quality engineering as a craft worth pushing forward. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.
